target_definition.metric: United States three-month Treasury yield monthly change

graph_diagnosis.summary: Inflation, policy stance, and rate expectations form a short-rate transmission chain.
weaknesses: Several nodes are broad historical context.
The graph lacks a direct observed yield node.

search_factors.why_search: Persistent inflation can sustain restrictive policy expectations.
Expected policy tightening anchors short-term rates.
Forward pricing provides a timely transmission measure.
Communication can reinforce or reverse rate expectations.

checkpoints.mechanism: Persistent inflation supports demand for restrictive monetary policy.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Recent inflation measures and inflation expectations.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Inflation falls rapidly or expectations ease.

checkpoints.mechanism: Expected tightening raises the expected path of short-term policy rates.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: FOMC actions, guidance, and policy-rate futures.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Guidance signals a pause or easing.

checkpoints.mechanism: Markets incorporate expected tightening into short-dated rate pricing.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Implied policy path and short-rate futures.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Futures reprice lower despite restrictive guidance.

checkpoints.mechanism: An upward short-rate forward curve signals higher near-term financing rates.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Forward curve changes across the observation month.

checkpoints.mechanism: Changes in expected policy rates and forward pricing transmit into three-month Treasury yields.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Daily three-month Treasury yields and contemporaneous rate expectations.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Treasury yields diverge from short-rate pricing.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Persistent inflation can sustain restrictive expectations that reprice short-term Treasury yields.
Restrictive guidance can lift the forward curve and transmit to short Treasury yields.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Markets expect policymakers to slow tightening despite inflation concerns.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Short-rate futures decline after policy communication.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Recession signals dominate and suppress short Treasury yields.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Curve inversion deepens while forward rates fall.

forecast_audit_questions: Did inflation data change the expected policy path?
Do futures and forward rates confirm higher short-rate pricing?
Is Treasury-yield movement aligned with the forward curve?
